text: Test names are extracted only from backticked spans of the whole line, not from the text following the marker. Scanning prose for (Test|Fuzz)[A-Za-z0-9_]+ treated English as an identifier, so a criterion whose commentary contained 'Tests' would hard-fail CI claiming it named a test that does not exist. Scoping to backticks also fixed the earlier attempt, which began mid-span and so found no names at all.
